content.text: Search index rebuild performance is hard to compare across changes because fixtures are hand-built and tiny.
Add benchmark fixtures that mirror production document shape distributions for the rebuild worker, including nested custom fields and large comment threads.
Wire the fixtures into a nightly job that reports wall time and peak memory so regressions are visible before release.
